sections.heading: 1. Introduction
sections.content: We, izowooi, are an independent developer that designs, develops and operates mobile applications. With this Privacy Policy, we explain how and why we collect, store, use, disclose and otherwise process personal data that we collect via our website, online advertisements and mobile applications (collectively, our "Services"). This Privacy Policy does not apply to any other data we collect, such as data we collect offline. If you have concerns about providing data to us or it being used as described in this Privacy Policy, please see Section 6 (Control Over Your Information) and Section 7 (Requests to Exercise Privacy Rights) of this Privacy Policy, or contact us at izowooi@hotmail.com.

sections.heading: 2. What Types of Personal Data We Collect and How We Collect It
sections.content:
Personal Data Collected Directly from You: We may collect the following types of personal data from you depending on how you use our Services and where you are located: Contact Information, including your country or region, name, e-mail address or username; User Generated Content, including any files, documents, images, data, or information you choose to upload or transmit through your communications with us or your use of our Services; Profile and Usage Information, such as your screen name or profile picture, your in-app progress, scores, achievements and payments, and details about how and when you use our Services; Survey Information, including feedback and ratings you provide relating to our Services; Inferences, such as information generated from your use of our Services, reflecting predictions about your interests and preferences.

Information We Collect Automatically: Depending on which of our Services you interact with and your location, we may automatically collect and process: Analytics Data, including a user ID associated with details about how you use and interact with our apps and other Services, event and conversion data, information about the device you use to access our Services, your IP address, operating system and version, internet browser type and version, crash logs and diagnostic information; Device Data, including your persistent and non-persistent unique device IDs, Identifier For Advertisers (IDFA) on iOS, Google Advertising ID on Android; Location Data, including your location based on your IP address.

Personal Data Collected from Third Parties: We may also collect personal data from third parties such as app marketplaces (Apple App Store, Google Play) when you download our applications or make in-app payments. We do not receive access to your credit card or bank account data when you make in-app payments through these app marketplaces.

sections.heading: 3. Purposes for Processing Your Personal Data
sections.content: We may use your personal data for the following purposes, depending on how you interact with our Services and your location: to provide our applications and ensure that the services you have paid for are activated, and to provide you with user support if you need it; to optimize our applications for you and for the device that you are using, as well as to deliver customized in-app events and offers; to verify your identity and entitlement to products or Services when you contact us or access our Services; to help maintain the safety, security and integrity of our Services, technology assets and business; to operate, improve and optimize our applications and other Services; to personalize our Services, understand our users and their preferences to enhance user experience; to communicate with you regarding Services-related information, including confirmations, technical notices, updates, security alerts and support messages; to respond to your comments and inquiries and provide customer support services; to prevent potentially prohibited or illegal activities, including fraud, and to protect our users; to comply with applicable laws, prevent fraud, and ensure compliance with our Terms of Service; to comply with contractual and legal obligations and requirements; to conduct internal research and analytics; and to engage in the marketing activities described in this Privacy Policy.

sections.heading: 4. Disclosure of Your Personal Data
sections.content: We may disclose personal data to the following types of third parties and in the below-mentioned circumstances: Service Providers: We may disclose your personal data to our service providers, including companies that provide us with IT and related services, assist us with customer service activities, provide analytics services that assist us in the improvement and optimization of our Services. We have executed appropriate contracts with the service providers that prohibit them from using or sharing personal data except as necessary to perform the contracted services on our behalf or to comply with applicable legal requirements. Disclosures to Protect Rights: We may access, preserve, and disclose your personal data to third parties if we believe doing so is required or appropriate to comply with law enforcement or legal processes, to protect rights, property or safety, to enforce our policies or contracts, or in connection with the establishment, exercise, or defense of legal claims. Ad Networks and Advertising Partners: We work with third-party ad networks and advertising partners to deliver advertising and personalized content. These parties may collect information directly from a browser or device when an individual visits our Services through cookies or other data collection technologies. With Your Consent: We may disclose personal data about an individual to certain other third parties or publicly with their consent or direction.

sections.heading: 5. Targeted Advertising
sections.content: We rely on third-party advertising networks and other advertising technology providers ("AdTech Providers") to serve targeted online ads. To enable these targeted ads, we may disclose the following types of personal data about users of our mobile applications and viewers of our ads to AdTech Providers: Identifier For Advertisers (IDFA) and Google Advertising ID, IP address, what Services of ours they have used, date and time of when they used our Services, and inferred interests. AdTech Providers use this information to make the online ads users see more relevant to their interests. This Privacy Policy does not apply to the collection and use of your personal data by AdTech Providers. We recommend that you review AdTech Providers' privacy policies for more information.

sections.heading: 6. Control Over Your Information
sections.content: There are a variety of ways in which you can control how our Services process your personal data. Delete or Reset our Services: If you delete our applications from your mobile device, we will no longer collect personal data via our applications on your mobile device and any data associated with our Services that is stored on your device may be deleted. However, we may still process any personal data we collected from you before you deleted our applications. You can also reset your mobile advertising identifier using your phone. Change our Services' Access to Your Device Information: You may control our Services' access to your device information through your device's Settings app. Deactivate Push Notifications: You may at any time opt-out from receiving push notifications by changing the relevant settings on your mobile device. Targeted Advertising: You can opt out of targeted advertising activities by changing your device's advertising settings. You can also choose to prevent your device's ad identifier from being used for interest-based advertising, or you can reset your device's ad identifier by changing your device's settings.

sections.heading: 7. Requests to Exercise Privacy Rights
sections.content: Depending on the privacy laws that apply to our use of your personal data, you may have some or all of the following privacy rights: Access to personal data; Correction or deletion of personal data; Restriction on processing personal data; Object to processing of personal data; Portability of personal data; Right to opt out of targeted advertising; Right to non-discrimination for exercising these rights; Right to withdraw consent at any time. To submit a request to exercise your privacy rights, you can contact us at izowooi@hotmail.com. We may need to request specific information from you to help us verify your identity. We will respond to requests to exercise privacy rights according to applicable laws.

sections.heading: 8. Children
sections.content: We do not intend to or knowingly collect personal data from children 12 and under. If a child 12 or under has provided personal data to us, we encourage the child's parent or guardian to contact us to request that we remove the personal data from our systems. If you are above the age of 12 but under the age of 18, you must ask your parent or legal guardian to read this Privacy Policy because you are not allowed to use our Services without their permission.

sections.heading: 9. Security
sections.content: We maintain physical, technical, electronic and procedural measures intended to protect personal data from unauthorized processing, including firewalls, data encryption technologies, and internal data security protocols. However, no server, computer or communications network or system, or data transmission over the internet can be guaranteed to be 100% secure. As a result, while we strive to protect your personal data, we cannot ensure or warrant the security of any personal data you transmit to us or through our Services.

sections.heading: 10. Third-Party Websites
sections.content: Our Services may include links to third-party websites, plug-ins and applications. Except where we post, link to or expressly adopt or refer to this Privacy Policy, this Privacy Policy does not apply to, and we are not responsible for, any personal data practices of third-party websites and online services. To learn about the personal data practices of third parties, please visit their respective privacy policies.

sections.heading: 11. Retention
sections.content: The length of time for which we retain personal data depends on the purposes for which we collect and use it and how long we need to retain it to comply with applicable laws, to establish, exercise or defend our legal rights, or to make the data available to courts or the competent public authorities. Once personal data is no longer necessary for these purposes, we delete it.

sections.heading: 12. Changes to This Privacy Policy
sections.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time, and we will post the updated Privacy Policy on this page. When we make changes to this Privacy Policy, we will change the date at the beginning of this Privacy Policy. If we make material changes, we will notify individuals through appropriate communication channels. Any new policy will be effective from the date it is published by us.

sections.heading: 13. Contact Us
sections.content: If you have any questions about our privacy practices or personal data processing activities, or would like to exercise your rights under privacy laws, you may contact us at izowooi@hotmail.com.
